purpose: Test whether an empirical reference-intensity-ratio reduction, implemented without TOPAS, crystal structures, Rietveld scale factors, or fitted whole-pattern peak shapes, transports from the official CPD instrument to the 208 Rowles profiles and exposes errors complementary to the frozen Rwp gate.

calibration.selectionReason: The three profiles are the phase-dominant simplex vertices and were fixed without using Rowles estimates or errors.
calibration.responseRatio: For phase k against fluorite in each calibration mixture s, compute log[(A_sk/A_s,fluorite)/(W_sk/W_s,fluorite)]. The median across 1a, 1b, and 1c is log(r_k/r_fluorite); set r_fluorite=1.
calibration.weightEstimate: For a target profile, set u_k=A_k/r_k and normalize positive u_k to 100 weight percent. Missing or non-positive phase area refuses the profile.

peakAreaContract.background: Use the median count in each low and high sideband, then linearly interpolate between the two sideband medians across the signal window.
peakAreaContract.area: Trapezoid-integrate max(observed count minus interpolated background, zero) over the observed signal points without resampling.
peakAreaContract.independence: Primary and secondary peak families are calibrated separately. No TOPAS result, crystal structure, Rwp, weighed Rowles composition, or target error enters either estimate.

targetGrid.adequateAcquisition: Nominal maximum intensity at least 20,000 counts and nominal step at most 0.04 degrees; all Rowles files extend to approximately 150 degrees 2theta.
targetGrid.unsafe: Maximum absolute phase-fraction error above five weight-percentage points.

frozenSelectors.peakAgreement: D is the maximum absolute phase-fraction difference between primary and secondary estimates.
frozenSelectors.developmentAgreementGate: On adequate-acquisition Rowles 1a profiles only, find the smallest D among unsafe primary estimates and accept D strictly below it. If adequate 1a has no unsafe estimate, the gate is non-identifiable and may not be promoted.
frozenSelectors.rwpGate: For comparison only, a TOPAS summary row passes when Rwp is strictly below the RC18-frozen threshold 8.043046005815. The threshold is not refitted.

competingHypotheses.claim: A three-peak empirical RIR calibrated on the historical CPD instrument transports to adequate Rowles acquisitions.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Across all 36 adequate Rowles profiles, the primary estimate has zero unsafe profiles and nonzero coverage in both compositions.
competingHypotheses.rejectWhen: Any adequate profile has maximum phase error above five points or a phase area is non-positive.

competingHypotheses.claim: Independent primary and secondary peak families agree closely enough to provide a transportable error detector.
competingHypotheses.prediction: The agreement gate selected only on 1a accepts zero unsafe 1e profiles and retains at least half of safe 1e profiles.
competingHypotheses.rejectWhen: It accepts any unsafe 1e profile, retains below 0.50 of safe 1e profiles, or is non-identifiable on 1a.

competingHypotheses.claim: The CPD phase-response ratio is composition invariant within its calibration instrument.
competingHypotheses.prediction: For both corundum/fluorite and zincite/fluorite, all three per-mixture response ratios lie within 20% of their median.
competingHypotheses.rejectWhen: Any relative deviation exceeds 20%, indicating composition, overlap, orientation, or background dependence before cross-instrument transfer.

competingHypotheses.claim: The non-TOPAS peak reduction and TOPAS Rwp expose complementary failure modes on the same raw files.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Among full-angle summary rows, at least one row passes Rwp while its independent profile is unsafe, and at least one row fails Rwp while its independent profile is safe.
competingHypotheses.rejectWhen: Either exclusive diagnostic group is empty.

decisionRules.primaryAccuracy: Report every phase error and the maximum phase error; do not average away a failing minor phase.
decisionRules.safety: A selector is safe only with zero accepted profiles above five points.
decisionRules.utility: Report accepted fraction and safe-profile retention; zero acceptance is not progress.
decisionRules.promotion: Passing this secondary benchmark does not qualify the independent physical rung because CPD and Rowles profiles are not a prospectively crossed preparation-by-institution experiment.

uncertaintyBudget: Poisson counting noise and coarse-grid sampling alter local integrated areas.
Linear sideband background can be biased by neighbouring peak tails.
Preferred orientation, microabsorption, crystallinity, and specimen packing change peak-specific response ratios.
The historical CPD and Rowles instruments differ in optics, resolution, alignment, and detector response.
The three calibration vertices are single physical profiles, so calibration uncertainty is descriptive rather than a preparation variance estimate.
Weighed values are treated as benchmark truth but do not replace independent elemental adjudication in the planned physical pilot.
stopConditions: Stop a profile estimate if any required signal or sideband window has no observed point or yields non-positive net area.
Do not tune centers, widths, background, response ratios, or the five-point gate after inspecting Rowles truth errors.
Do not describe agreement between two peak families as independent physical replication; both use the same specimen and raw file.
Do not promote an Rwp or agreement refusal rule after any unsafe holdout acceptance.
